HOW DID FREE SPEECH IN AMERICA TURN TO SHIT?
Empire fatigue is part of the story, along with a collective loss of confidence. The post-WWII empire years
in America have been exhausting, with lots of expensive, lost, wars, political scandals, a rising oligarchy,
an aging prison-industrial complex and the disappearance of any original, blues-based rock n' roll - and

influencers and shitcoiners sending incomprehensible semaphores from the cells of their casino gulags

The infinite value of dematerialization
and nothingness is priceless and inevitable.
The infinite, digital casbah of price discovery is opaque, unfathomable, ineffable and
omnipresent. It is a void of cosmic emptiness; where space and time mean nothing, trading
is virtually free, and price discovery is perfect. Interstellar blackness is punctuated by
unreachable stars getting more unfathomable as we get deeper into the quantum realities
of Schrödinger's cats, both alive and dead, turned into cat memes, neither here nor there.
It is omnipresent in our nonexistence. We can no longer hide from the watchful eye of the
supernatural, high up on the edge of consciousness, the bending heart of unrequited love
of Satoshi and the moments we can't remember as clearly as any we have forgotten while
we watch the global population swell in a cacophonous riot of screams, laughter and UTXOs.
Bitcoin sees it all.
And by dematerializing and decentralizing, it saves us here in the perceived
universe so that we can rid ourselves of our lying selves; of lying cause-and-

Leave all the power to the protocol. It will take it all. The path to dematerialization
is electrified by every kilowatt available and then some. We need all the
power we can muster to get rid of ourselves to save ourselves.
